questions.q: Actuals [100, 0, 400] and predictions [120, 10, 360]. What is the RMSPE (decimal)? Ignore the zero day.
Why are zero-sales days ignored in the RMSPE score?
options: Percentage error divides by the actual, which is zero

questions.q: Which feature can NOT be used because it is missing in the test file?

options: Squared error on the log scale is close to squared relative error
